_readme: Help-bot user manual. Edit freely. Each entry: id (unique), title, module, route (screen the 'Open' button goes to; omit for info-only), gate (optional route whose permission decides who sees the entry, defaults to route; entry with neither is visible to everyone), menuPath (text path shown to the user), keywords (extra words/synonyms incl. Malayalam-in-English), summary, steps[], tips[]. inPage (optional) = what to do inside the screen after it opens, for tabs/filters/buttons a link cannot reach. Routes must exist in app_router.dart. DRAFT - generated from the code, needs owner review.

entries.title: Dashboard
entries.summary: The overview home page shown after login.
steps: Tap Dashboard in the sidebar (Home tab on mobile).
Use the cards to see today's headline numbers; tap a card to drill into it.
tips: What you see depends on your role.

entries.title: Notifications
entries.summary: All alerts sent to you in the CRM.
steps: Tap the bell icon at the top (mobile) or Notifications in the sidebar.
Tap a notification to open the related item.

entries.title: My Profile
entries.summary: Your own account details. Logout is in the sidebar too.
steps: Open My Profile from the sidebar.
Review or update your details.
To sign out use Logout at the bottom of the sidebar.

entries.title: Report a bug / problem
entries.summary: Send a problem report to the team from the bottom of the sidebar.
steps: Scroll to the bottom of the sidebar and tap Report Bug.
Describe what happened and what you expected, then send.

entries.title: Clients directory
entries.summary: Directory of all clients with profiles and history.
steps: Open Clients from the sidebar.
Search by name or phone.
Tap a client to open their profile.

entries.title: Client Reviews
entries.summary: Reviews and ratings clients have given.
steps: Open Client Reviews from the sidebar.
Open a review to read or respond.

entries.title: Client Chat
entries.summary: Chat with clients who use the bridal app.
steps: Open Client Chat from the sidebar.
Pick a conversation and reply.

entries.title: App Clients (brides)
entries.summary: Brides registered in the client mobile app.
steps: Open App Clients from the sidebar.
Search and tap a bride to see her details.

entries.title: Calendar (works scheduler)
entries.summary: Calendar of booked works; check dates and artist availability.
steps: Open Calendar from the sidebar.
Pick the date or month.
Tap a booking on a date to see or manage it.

entries.title: Add a booking
entries.summary: Create a new booking for a customer.
steps: Open Booking in the sidebar and choose Add Booking.
Enter the customer, event date, package/service and region.
Record the advance payment if received.
Save. The customer can receive a booking confirmation on WhatsApp (see the WhatsApp entry).
tips: A booking from a lead is usually created from the lead's quote/invoice flow.

entries.title: Booking requests
entries.summary: All booking requests; open one to manage it.
steps: Open Booking → Booking Requests.
Search or filter the list.
Tap a booking to open Manage Booking (edit, assign artist, update status).

entries.title: Trials
entries.summary: Trial calendar and studio trial bookings.
steps: Open Trials from the sidebar.
Use the calendar to see trial slots, or the list view for all trials.
Tap a trial to manage it.

entries.title: Trial packages
steps: Open Trials → Trial Packages.
Add or edit a package and save.

entries.title: Services & packages
entries.summary: Packages and prices. Quotes and invoices take package prices from here.
steps: Open Services from the sidebar.
Tap a package to view/edit, or add a new one.
Set the base price and any district prices, then save.
tips: Changing a price here changes it for new quotes.

entries.title: Regions (Geographics)
steps: Open Geographics under Services.
Add or edit regions/districts.

entries.title: Add-on services
entries.summary: Extra services that can be added to a package.
steps: Open Services → Add-ons.
Add or edit an add-on and save.

entries.title: Sales Dashboard
steps: Open Sales → Sales Dashboard.
Change the period to see different dates.
Tap a figure to drill into the detail.

entries.title: My Sales Dashboard (sales team)
entries.summary: A sales person's own home with their leads and targets.
steps: Tap Home (first tab) in the sales app.
See your targets, follow-ups and recent leads.

entries.inPage: After it opens: tap New to add a lead
entries.title: Leads Data Entry
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → Sales → Leads Data Entry (sales team: Leads tab)
entries.summary: Enter, search and follow up leads.
steps: Open Sales → Leads Data Entry.
Tap New to add a lead (or use Smart Paste to fill from a pasted message).
Use the filters (for example Added By) and search to find leads.
Open a lead to log activity, set follow-ups or move it forward.
Export Leads downloads the list.
tips: Duplicates: the app warns if a lead for the same phone already exists; use Open existing lead.
Marking a lead Lost may need approval — an approver sees Review Lost request.

entries.inPage: After it opens: tap a lead, then Add Activity Log
entries.title: Log activity / follow-up on a lead
entries.menuPath: Leads Data Entry → open a lead → Add Activity Log
entries.summary: Record what happened with a lead and when to follow up next.
steps: Open Sales → Leads Data Entry and tap the lead (Open Full Details for the whole page).
Tap Add Activity Log.
Write the outcome and choose the next follow-up.
Save.

entries.inPage: After it opens: tap a lead, then the Quote tab
entries.title: Create a quote / quotation
entries.menuPath: Leads Data Entry → open a lead → Quote tab
entries.summary: Build a quotation for a lead from packages, add-ons and custom services.
steps: Open the lead in Sales → Leads Data Entry.
Go to the quote builder (quote tab).
Choose packages — use Compare packages to show several side by side.
Add add-ons or Add custom service if needed; for multi-day events use Multi-day program.
Download PDF or Print, or send it on WhatsApp (see the WhatsApp entry).
tips: Package prices come from Services (district price when a district is chosen). A price changed in the quote applies on this device only. An empty price shows 'Price on request'.

entries.inPage: After it opens: use the Package filter at the top
entries.title: Invoices & Bookings (sales)
entries.summary: List of confirmed bookings with their invoices and payment status; filter by period, status and package.
steps: Open Sales → Invoices & Bookings.
Choose the period/date range at the top.
Use the Package filter to show only bookings of a particular package.
Tap a booking to see its invoice, payments and balance.
Download, print or send the invoice on WhatsApp from there.
tips: Official invoice numbers (TN series) are given only to completed and fully paid bookings.

entries.title: Monthly Bookings
steps: Open Sales → Monthly Bookings.
Pick the month with the navigation arrows.
Tap a day or row to see the bookings.

entries.title: Quarterly Performance
steps: Open Quarterly Performance from the Sales menu.
Pick the quarter.

entries.title: Cancelled Works
steps: Open Sales → Cancelled Works.
Filter by period; open an item for details.

entries.title: Booking Map
steps: Open Sales → Booking Map.
Zoom into an area and tap a marker for the booking.

entries.title: Sales Targets
entries.summary: Set monthly targets for each sales person (for people allowed to set targets).
steps: Open Sales → Sales Targets.
Choose the month.
Enter each person's target — Copy last month fills last month's values.
Tap Save targets.
tips: Only certain roles can set targets; others do not see this entry.

entries.title: Report & Goals
entries.summary: Day / week / month report of achieved sales against the company goals.
steps: Open Sales → Report & Goals.
Choose Day, Week or Month and use the arrows to move the period.
Pick the basis (when bookings were added vs. event date) if offered.
Compare Achieved against the Pro-rated goal / Month goal.

entries.title: Set company goals
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → Sales → Report & Goals → Set goals
entries.summary: Set the company day/week/month goals used in Report & Goals.
steps: Open Report & Goals and tap Set goals.
Pick the period type and date.
Enter the goal for each metric; clear a value to remove that goal.
Tap Save goals.
tips: Only roles allowed to edit goals can save.

entries.title: Sales Calendar
entries.summary: Calendar view of sales activity and follow-ups.
steps: Open Sales → Sales Calendar.
Pick a date to see items.

entries.inPage: After it opens: tap a booking, then the WhatsApp button (for a quote: lead → Quote tab)
entries.title: Send quotation / invoice on WhatsApp
entries.menuPath: Quote or Invoice screen → WhatsApp option
entries.summary: Send a quotation or invoice PDF to the customer through TeamN Chat (WhatsApp).
steps: Open the quote (on a lead) or the invoice (Invoices & Bookings).
Choose the WhatsApp send option.
Pick 'Send to WhatsApp team' to leave it waiting in the customer's chat for staff, or 'Send to customer now' to deliver immediately.
If it fails, the screen shows TeamN Chat's reason (for example template not approved).
tips: The customer's phone number must be on the lead/booking.

entries.title: Accounts Dashboard
steps: Open Accounts → Combined Dashboard.

entries.title: Cash In / Out
entries.summary: Record and review money received and paid.
steps: Open Accounts → Cash In / Out.
Add an entry (in or out), choosing the account, amount, date and category.
Save and check it in the list.

entries.title: Invoices (accounts)
steps: Open Accounts → Invoice.
Search or filter, then open an invoice.

entries.title: Bills & Payables
entries.summary: Vendor bills and what is due to be paid.
steps: Open Accounts → Bills & Payables.
Add a bill or open an existing one.
Record payment when paid.

entries.title: Artist Collections
entries.summary: Money artists collected from customers on the day.
steps: Open Accounts → Operations → Artist Collection.
Review and verify collections.

entries.title: Artist Payouts
steps: Open Accounts → Operations → Artist Payouts.
Select the artist/work and record the payout.

entries.title: Fleet Expenses (accounts)
steps: Open Accounts → Operations → Fleet Expenses.
Open an expense to approve or pay.

entries.title: Staff / Operations payouts
steps: Open Accounts → Operations → Staff Payouts.
Pick the month and process the payouts.

entries.title: Administrative Expenses
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → Accounts → Administrative → Expenses (department heads: Department Expenses)
entries.summary: Submit and approve office / department expenses.
steps: Open Accounts → Administrative → Expenses (department heads use Department Expenses).
Add an expense with amount, category and bill.
Accounts reviews and approves the payment.

entries.title: Software & Subscriptions
steps: Open Accounts → Administrative → Subscriptions.
Add or edit a subscription.

entries.title: Administrative Salaries
steps: Open Accounts → Administrative → Salaries.
Pick the month and process payment.

entries.title: Attendance Payroll
steps: Open Accounts → Administrative → Attendance Payroll.
Pick the month and review.

entries.title: Sales Returns / Credit Notes
entries.summary: Record refunds and credit notes against sales.
steps: Open Accounts → Administrative → Sales Returns.
Add a credit note against the booking/invoice.

entries.title: HRA (House Rent Allowance)
steps: Open Accounts → Administrative → HRA.

entries.title: Budget
steps: Open Accounts → Budget.

entries.title: Uploaded Reports (accounts)
steps: Open Accounts → Uploaded Reports.

entries.title: Artist Finance
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → Accounts → Operations → Artist Finance (artists: Finance tab)
steps: Open Artist Finance (artists: the Finance tab).
Add a collection or claim and submit.

entries.title: Company Finance dashboard
steps: Open Finance → Dashboard.

entries.inPage: After it opens: pick the report tile you need
entries.title: Finance Reports Center
entries.summary: Entry point to P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, Ledger, Receivables & Payables, GST and more.
steps: Open Finance → Reports.
Choose the report and the period.

entries.title: Company Assets
steps: Open Finance → Assets.
Add or review assets.

entries.title: Bank Balance
steps: Open Finance → Bank Balance.

entries.title: Financial Report (CEO)
steps: Open Finance → Financial Report.

entries.title: Company Reports (document library)
steps: Open Company Reports from the sidebar.
Pick the department and open or upload a report.

entries.title: Staff Directory
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → HRMS → People & Organization → Staff Directory
entries.summary: All employees; add or edit staff.
steps: Open HRMS → People & Organization → Staff Directory.
Tap a person to view/edit or add a new employee.

entries.title: Attendance
steps: Open HRMS → Time & Attendance → Attendance.
Pick the date or month.

entries.title: Apply for / manage leave
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → Leave (HRMS → Time & Attendance → Leave Management)
entries.summary: Apply for leave and see your balance.
steps: Open Leave.
Choose to apply, pick the type and dates, add a reason.
Submit; your manager decides it in Approvals.

entries.title: Approvals
entries.summary: Review and decide leave and HR requests from your team.
steps: Open Approvals.
Open a request and approve or reject with a comment.

entries.title: Attendance Regularization
steps: Open Regularization.
Choose the day and the correct times with a reason.
Submit for approval.

entries.title: Shifts & Roster
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → HRMS → Time & Attendance → Shifts & Roster
steps: Open Shifts & Roster.

entries.title: Time Tracker
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → HRMS → Time & Attendance → Time Tracker
steps: Open Time Tracker.
Fill the week's hours and submit.

entries.title: Slot Management
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → HRMS → Time & Attendance → Slot Management
entries.summary: Manage booking slots and artist availability.
steps: Open Slot Management.
Use Slot Capacity (same menu) to set how many bookings a slot allows.

entries.title: Salaries & Payroll (HR)
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → HRMS → Payroll & Compensation → Salaries & Payroll
steps: Open HRMS → Payroll & Compensation → Salaries & Payroll.
Pick the month.

entries.title: Reimbursements
steps: Open Reimbursements.
Add a claim with amount and bill, and submit.

entries.title: Travel requests
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → HRMS → Payroll & Compensation → Travel Expenses
steps: Open Travel Expenses.
Create a request and submit.

entries.title: 5-Pillar Evaluation
steps: Open 5-Pillar Evaluation.
Pick the employee and period, score and save.

entries.title: Recruitment
steps: Open Recruitment.
Add a job post or candidate.

entries.title: Grievances
steps: Open Grievances.
Raise a case with details.

entries.title: Policies & Handbook
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → HRMS → Workplace & Culture → Policies & Handbook
steps: Open Policies & Handbook.

entries.title: Inventory Dashboard
steps: Open Inventory → Dashboard.

entries.title: Stock List
steps: Open Inventory → Stock List.
Add or edit an item; adjust quantity.

entries.title: Staff Kits
entries.menuPath: Sidebar → Inventory → Staff Kits (artists: My Kits)
entries.summary: Kits assigned to staff. Assigning a kit deducts studio stock.
steps: Open Inventory → Staff Kits.
Pick a staff member and assign items.

entries.title: Purchases
steps: Open Inventory → Purchases and add a purchase.

entries.title: Restock Alerts
steps: Open Inventory → Restock Alerts.

entries.title: Expiry Tracker
steps: Open Inventory → Expiry Tracker.

entries.title: Fleet vehicles (cars)
steps: Open Fleet → Cars.
Add or edit a vehicle.

entries.title: Drivers
steps: Open Fleet → Drivers.

entries.title: Fleet assignments
entries.summary: Assign vehicles and drivers to works.
steps: Open Fleet → Assignments.
Choose the work, then the vehicle and driver.

entries.title: Fuel & fleet expenses
steps: Open Fleet → Expenses.
Add an expense with amount and bill.

entries.title: Marketing Dashboard
entries.summary: Marketing overview; other marketing screens (Competitors, Weekly Score, Insights, Analytics, Campaigns, Leads Report) are in the same menu.
steps: Open Marketing → Dashboard.
Use the Marketing menu items for the detailed screens.

entries.title: Company Projects
steps: Open Company Projects.
Open a project to see its tasks.

entries.title: Help Desk tickets
steps: Open Help Desk.
Create a ticket with details; track its status.

entries.title: Backup Data
entries.summary: Backup/export of data you have access to.
steps: Open Backup Data from the bottom of the sidebar.

entries.title: Settings (users & roles)
steps: Open Settings.
Edit a role to switch features and sub-sections on or off for it.
tips: If a menu item is missing for someone, the role is missing that permission.

entries.title: I can't see a screen / menu item
entries.summary: Menu items depend on your role. If a screen is missing, your role does not include it.
steps: Check you are in the right workspace (workspace switcher at the top, if shown).
Ask an administrator to add the feature to your role in Settings → Roles.
